d1.review.failed.pathOutsideRepository: A path left the target, so it was refused rather than clamped.

d12.conflict.title: Conflict hunks
d12.conflict.notMerge: Two sides plus the patch preimage — not a merge result. Core computes no merge base and resolves nothing here, so there is no merged text and no resolve action.
d12.conflict.truncated: Over Core's byte bound: at least one file's hunks were dropped.
d12.conflict.omitted: Hunks not shown — this file's lines were over Core's byte bound.
d12.conflict.noHunks: Core listed this file with no hunks.
d12.conflict.noFiles: Core published conflict content naming no file.
d12.conflict.ours: OURS · the Lane's current file, from line {line}
d12.conflict.theirs: THEIRS · the incoming patch, from line {line}
d12.conflict.base: BASE · what the patch expected to find
d12.conflict.base.absent: This hunk carried no preimage at all.
d12.conflict.base.empty: The patch expected an empty region here.
d12.conflict.emptySide: Core read no lines on this side.
d12.conflict.reason.context_mismatch.rem: The preimage was not found in the file. The origin Lane has to re-derive its patch against the current content; nothing can be applied from here.
d12.conflict.reason.already_applied.reme: The file already holds this hunk's new side at that range, so there is nothing left to apply.
d12.conflict.reason.file_missing.remedy: The patch changes a file that is not in the target tree. This is a file-level decision, not a hunk-level one.
d12.conflict.reason.file_deleted.remedy: The deletion's preimage does not account for the whole file, so the file would be left behind. This is a file-level decision.
d12.conflict.reason.binary.remedy: Core reported the content as non-text, so there are no lines to match.
d12.conflict.reason.unnamed.remedy: This build does not name Core's reason, so it is shown exactly as Core published it.
d12.conflict.absent.record: Core published no structured conflict content for this bounce. A bounce an operator raised with a reason has no failed apply behind it and carries none by contract.
d12.conflict.absent.capability: Core publishes no structured conflict content ({capability}), so the conflicting hunk cannot be shown.
